reviews.x: These travel bottles deserve 10 stars!! Very high quality, I love the color of the silicone bottles, very easily filled & functional. The sticker labels included are pretty neat as well. They stick perfect onto the white plastic part on the lid (as pictured)

I've taken these on about five trips so far.  They've endured air pressure and altitude changes from flying and have spent quality time in a hot car.  Not even a hint of a leak so far - I love it.  These are soft, durable, and seal well.  They were easy to fill, as the mouths are relatively wide.  They dispense well, although I've yet to test them on something with an extremely thin consistency.  So far, I've filled them with lotion, shampoo, conditioner, sunscreen, and hair gel.  Would buy agai

reviews.t: overall good with one quality control issue that was easily fixable.
reviews.x: I got this a month ago. I only just tried using it today for a vacation trip. the silicone bottle feels very good and durable. One of the three bottles leaked air and liquid. On further inspection, the silicone lip had a small fragment still attached similar to being tongue tied (where the lingual frenulum is still attached to the bottom of the tongue) preventing the silicon from wrapping completely around the plastic throat piece so when the cap was screwed on, that area did hot have a good sea

I bought this kit for a trip and the bottles were very good quality. I will now use these bottles on a regular basis in my gym bag. The large mouth of the bottle makes for easy filling. They are light and don't weigh anything. And very squeezable to make sure you get every drop out. P.S. Right after I purchased these, I saw the same bottle at Whole Foods, but it was $12 just for one; not the complete set as is sold here ;0)

reviews.t: Terrible at dispensing small amounts of product, discoloration
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:8a40d0022f5d21c267b0384ee26834dc]] My friend bought these for me because I'm going abroad soon, however, these are essentially useless for travel. They are easy to fill and are leakproof, but these squirt out huge amounts of product when using shampoo and conditioner. It's almost impossible to dispense a small amount. So, when I was in the shower with a handful of shampoo that I did not need, I was not pleased. Also, the bottles holding my sunscreen and conditioner (both of which also

These are amazing and work perfect. Durable. Stay closed in travel. Easy to fill and easy to get the last drop out. Also simple to clean with dish soap and warm water. Great travel investment for picky people like me who like to have their product in travel size!

reviews.t: The bottles do not close well
reviews.x: The bottles do not close well and the closure costs to open, in such a way that the product spills easily.

If you've ever tried to put toothpaste back in a tube, you know it's not easy. I manage a donkey sanctuary and make my own first aid ointment and desperately needed something that would keep the contents clean and be easy to get out. These containers are absolutely perfect!! Even with a tiny bit left in the container it's easily removed. With 4, I'm not sure when or if I'll need more, but if I do, I will definitely purchase these again.

I have rheumatoid disease and psoriatic arthritis and squeezing regular bottle of conditioner is next to impossible. I saw these little bottles and was elated. Yes they do exactly what I needed. Now getting the conditioner into them was not easy, so I elicited the assistance of my son. But, that is my issue, not a defect with the bottles.

reviews.t: Hold a lot of product without taking up too much space
reviews.x: While I can't speak to how these bottles will hold up over time, they are a great size for storing my shampoo, conditioner, soap, and all the essentials for my travels. They hold a lot of product without leaking, and they fit nicely in my quart-size toiletry bag. Also, I love the different colors! Very pleased so far.

reviews.t: Bottles are great, bag they come in...not so great
reviews.x: We bought 2 of these for a 2week trip and put them in our carry on.  Before I even got through TSA security, the bag that one of the sets were in broke out on the bottom.  We borrowed packing tape from a TSA man to keep it shut.  I love the bottles, they work great and they're a great size.

reviews.t: Just Unboxed and Already Down to Three Stars
reviews.x: Just got them and already down to three stars. The plastic zippered bag that came with the bottle arrived torn. Not worth the hassle or returning. Will update the review once the bottles are used on a few trips.
I'm very happy with these bottles. They are easy to squeeze, didn't leak, and aren't slippery in the shower.

Update Jan 2021: These are still holding up great! They have survived a couple of falls and I may buy more for keeping lotion around the house in the winter.  Original: Awesome little containers. Squishy so it’s easy to get contents out unlike other travel bottles from the grocery store! They hold a lot of product. Also, I’ve been on several trips with them since September (2018) and they haven’t leaked. (If you think they are leaking, it may just be water stuck in the cap from the shower. I dra

I liked the size of these bottles and the leakproof quality touted by other reviewers.  My only negative would be that these are definitely for thick(er) substances, not water density ones as the plastic is SO squishy that when you squeeze even the slightest amount, the liquid comes out VERY fast.  I put gel hand sanitizer in one of mine and the first squeeze was a quarter size - need to be more careful and squeeze very gently! They have a star opening - not a thin spout - which opens only furth

Overall, product works well. Containers are leak-proof, easy to squeeze. Contents do come out as a thin jet, but it's not too hard to control and is a fair trade-off for the leak protection.  Docking one star though, because one bottle was so leak-proof it didn't have a dispenser hole cut, so I had to poke one in it myself. Not a hard fix, but maybe production could use a bit more polish.

Pros: I love the silicone colors and pre-made labels that comes with the kit! It makes life so much easier! It was easy to squeeze the shampoo and conditioner that I have at home into these travel bottles.  Con: When showering, I opened up the bottles to use my conditioner. I took a little strong push to dispense the conditioner... and my conditioner went all over my body.

These are absolutely fabulous for shampoo, conditioner, lotion, etc.  I used a few for mouthwash and they were not as functional. My mistake really. I learned my lesson when I squeezed.  So for anything of a thicker consistency these are awesome.  Write on with a Sharpie or use enclosed labels. Love the different colors. Will order again.

I use this so I don’t have to lug 4 different bottles of products to my communal shower, and it’s wonderful. The amount of annoyance that comes with having to have your hands full of shower products trying to get back into to your dorm room and nearly dropping everything is unmatched. These are great. Easy to squeeze and easy to fill.

I wish regular everyday products were packaged like these. So easy to use. Mess free. Always ready to dispense. I did think how silly to spend money on these bottles when you can buy travel sized items but this way you bring what you use normally and you feel good not adding more plastic than needed to the environment.

I was surprised by the seemingly high quality of these.  The bag is soft plastic and doesn't appear to tear quickly.  The bottles are thick and the caps tight.  I anticipate a cap may crack,  but that happens with shampoo bottles too. As a bonus surprise,  I appreciated the labels for what is in the bottles.

Was just looking for some travel containers. These are great. The rubber is sandwiched between the plastic pieces so it holds really tight. There is a nozzle/gasket thing that keeps air from going back in once you have squeezed out your product. Makes for easy dispensing.

These are good, but I noticed that over time some liquids tend to dry out in these bottles. Not a major inconvenience for something that keeps liquids inside the bottle rather than the cheap plastic bottles that always pop open on flights and get all over my stuff.

Sorry for the delay in submitting my review. I was waiting until I could actually use the products and fly with it except for a. I have to say I'm absolutely thrilled. Every other system I've tried there's been some leaking. NOT this time around… happy camper

These bottles are great. They are silicone, making it much easier to get product out versus a harder plastic. They also have a wide mouth so it was easy to fill them up. They survived several long flights, leak-free. I recommend these for your travel needs.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the bottles as durable, high-quality, and leakproof for travel.
Many reviewers find the bottles easy to fill thanks to the wide mouths, and easy to squeeze out the last drop.
A few reviewers report leaking or poor closure issues with individual bottles.
Some reviewers note the bottles dispense thin liquids too quickly and are better suited to thicker products.
A couple of reviewers report the included plastic zippered bag arrived torn or broke easily.
